notes:
Core features and improvements through version 1.0.12:

COURSES AND ANALYSIS
• Desktop interface for selecting DVH files and entering fractionation and course gaps.
• Responsive course layout that wraps into columns, with scrolling when needed.
• Patient name read from the last course’s DVH file.
• Input review before calculation, progress feedback and diagnostic error logs.

PHYSICISTS AND BRANDING
• Searchable physicist dropdown with locally saved additions and removals.
• Yenzakahle logo, consistent window icons and yellow-accented interface.
• Help window containing workflow and reporting instructions.

ORGAN SELECTION AND RESULTS
• Searchable selection of structures common to the chosen courses.
• Hover list explaining which structures were excluded.
• Interactive vertical NTCP chart that resizes with the window.
• Results-stage organ screening with Clear all and Restore all controls.
• Screened organ selections carried through to the HTML report.

HTML REPORTING
• Print full report opens the HTML in a browser, ready to print or save as PDF.
• Supplied Yenzakahle logo embedded locally for offline viewing.
• Removed per-course results, recovery sensitivity table and directors footer.
• Compact clinical-goal tables grouped by structure, showing objective and result.
• Green results for met goals, red for not met and grey for not evaluable, with a legend and summary counts.
• Expandable goal references and notes.
• Notes, clinical disclaimer, Prepared by and footer placed together on a dedicated final print page.

CLINICAL GOALS
• Fixed bladder and lens maximum-dose checks incorrectly showing Not evaluable.
• Settings displays built-in goals for structures common to the selected DVHs.
• Add a goal using +, select an OAR and type an objective such as V30Gy<30%.
• Supports maximum dose, mean dose, volume above a dose in percent or cc, and dose at a percentage volume.
• Validates objective notation and supports strict and inclusive comparisons: <, <=, > and >=.
• Local goals can be edited or removed; default goals can be removed and restored.
• Goal settings persist locally and apply after recalculation, without changing NTCP model parameters.

SETTINGS AND UPDATES
• Optional report/signing folder link, configurable per Windows account.
• Separate private Google Drive folder for application downloads.
• Background startup update check using a public GitHub version file.
• Manual Check for updates button, release notes and download-folder button.
• Improved handling of cached GitHub version information.

SIGNATURES — VERSION 1.0.12
• Signature window appears before opening the full report.
• Draw using a mouse or touchscreen, or type a name rendered in cursive.
• Clear, Sign & open report and Skip controls.
• Signature embedded above Prepared by at a print-friendly size.
• Skip leaves the signature area blank; closing the window cancels report opening.
• No reusable signature is stored by the app.

Recalculate and generate a new report to apply updated goals and report formatting. Settings, physicists and goal preferences are saved locally for each Windows account.
